test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which party formed the government in Odisha after the 2024 Assembly elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatiya Janata Party**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** is one of the two major political parties in India, along with the Indian National Congress.
 
• The BJP's political ideology is centered around **Hindutva**, which seeks to promote Hindu values and culture.
 
• The party was founded in **1980** as the political wing of the **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)**.
 
• It has been in power in various states and at the central level multiple times, with significant electoral victories in recent years.
 
• The BJP is known for its focus on **economic reforms, national security, and infrastructure development**.
 
• In the 2024 Assembly elections in Odisha, the BJP managed to secure a majority and formed the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)**__

 __
 
• The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** was founded in **2012** by **Arvind Kejriwal** and other social activists.
 
• The party emerged from the **India Against Corruption movement** and focuses on issues like **anti-corruption, education, and healthcare**.
 
• AAP has a significant presence in **Delhi**, where it has formed the government multiple times.
 
 
 
• **Janata Dal (United)**__
 __
 
• **Janata Dal (United)** is a center-left political party primarily active in the state of **Bihar**.
 
• The party was formed in **1999** through the merger of the Janata Dal factions and is led by **Nitish Kumar**.
 
• JD(U) emphasizes **social justice, secularism, and regional development**.
 
 
 
• **Indian National Congress**__
 
 
• The **Indian National Congress** is one of the oldest political parties in India, founded in **1885**.
 
• The party played a crucial role in the **Indian independence movement** against British rule.
 
• Congress has a center-left political stance, focusing on **social justice, economic development, and secularism**.
